page.overview:
Who is Donatello Splinterson?

Donatello is one of the main protagonists of the . He is the smartest and most technologically-adept . His personality is still the traditional technology Turtle, but unlike most other incarnations, he is the most passive and is rarely aggressive. His trademark bō is his primary weapon, but he has used other weapons such as laser guns and those of his brothers.

Donatello is a mutant turtle with olive green skin who wears a purple bandana and brown paddings on his knees, elbows and wrists.

Donatello is the brains of the bunch. Like in the Mirage comics, Donatello has a complex personality. Several episodes concentrate on him, as well as his emotional and intellectual struggles. He is very book smart, a skilled technician, and has a tendency to think things through. He shows a greater interest in science and education than his ninjutsu training.

Donatello will defend his brothers at any cost, and he frequently assists the team in many ways through the technology he develops, mostly vehicles and communication devices. He also can use ninjitsu and his Bo Staff when necessary. Donatello is very prepared for situations especially with his gadgets. For instance during the Turtles' infiltration of the , where Don carried all the equipment and gadgets they would need in his duffel bag.
